title: Sort an inbox, assembled
sub: Classify the message, extract a ticket record, and pause before filing anything costly or unclear.

steps.d:
"Subject: Refund? — the drain pump I bought (HLV-2205)
failed after three weeks, can I get the $46.00 back?"

steps.h: Your code asks the model for one label
Your code reads the label and picks a handler
steps.d:
label='billing' -> billing handler
(the support and general handlers were not taken this run)

steps.h: The model extracts a ticket record in a fixed shape
Your code checks the gate and pauses the run
steps.d:
reason=high_cost (a dollar figure is in the record)
the run returns a checkpoint here; no ticket is filed
until a person decides
(the direct pass-through to Ticket filed, below, was not taken this run)

steps.h: A person reviews the paused ticket and decides
steps.d:
sees: the full message, the extracted record, reason: high_cost
decides: approve

steps.h: Your code resumes and files the ticket
